text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: sev2 KV hotkey fanout detected in us-west-2. spike ~200k req/s to /generate, KV miss_rate high. auto-throttle engaged.
Eve (oncall): Saw the pager, jumping in. Paging Ben for infra assist.
Ben: On it. can you paste the aggregated metrics/logs?
Eve (oncall): Pasting tail of aggregated metrics:
```
kvlookup miss_rate=0.78 hotkey=tenant:54321:prefix requests=198k/s latency_p50=120ms error_rate=2.1% prefetch_queue=980
```
Carla: Prefetch queue is backed up on gw-12, observed repeated prefetch failures. looks like prefetching is amplifying reads.
Miguel: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) tenant-level soft RPS cap for tenant 54321 2) disable KV prefetch on affected shard 3) enable prefix-bypass for correctness to avoid stale cache path 4) traffic-shape to fallback model variant.
Eve (oncall): prefer incremental steps, less customer-impacting first.
Ben: Applying soft quota carveout now:
`/admin/tenants/54321/quota set --rps=50 --reason="hotkey mitigation"`
... applied.
ops-bot: Quota change recorded: tenant=54321 rps=50 by Ben at 3155001250
Eve (oncall): Disabling prefetch on shard gw-12:
```
cfgctl set gw-12.kv.prefetch.enabled=false --dry-run=false
```
... done.
Carla: Enabling prefix bypass (reads served direct) to preserve correctness. this will route reads around the cached KV path.
Miguel: Rolling a traffic-shape to shift majority to fallback variant (smaller cache footprint):
```
trafficctl route --match "tenant=54321" --split "fallback=90,primary=10"
```
Eve (oncall): Starting handoff to Ben for ~30m while I collate customer impact + draft notify. Ben, you have pager.
Ben: Ack taking pager. will monitor metrics and keep quota in place.
Carla: Customer impact summary: ~22 tenants saw elevated p95 latency, 3 customers triggered 5xx spikes, support queue has 4 open tickets. drafting a short notify: "Investigating elevated latencies; temporary rate limits applied to mitigate impact."
Eve (oncall): Action items: 1) plan KV cache warmup after traffic normalizes 2) schedule targeted eviction of hot prefixes overnight 3) evaluate prefetch throttling vs full disable on a canary shard.
Miguel: Created runbook entry "hotkey-fanout-trench" and postmortem stub.
ops-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-3155001 severity=2 assignees=Ben,Eve
Eve (oncall): Handoff complete — leaving to Ben for monitoring. ping me for customer comms or if we need escalation. :white_check_mark:
Ben: Will post 15m checkpoints in this thread and update when metrics stabilize. starting 15m monitor window now.
